plan: Index the catalog by target ingredient name, pre-sorting each option list by (priority, catalog position) so the best choice is always options[0] and selection is deterministic.

Adapt each ingredient with a chain loop: while its current name is excluded, apply the best catalog choice (name, quantity_factor, unit, preparation), tracking visited names in a seen-set to detect substitution cycles and emitting 'no substitution for NAME' when no option exists.

Process ingredient lists through a work queue; additional ingredients introduced by a substitution are appended to the queue and pass through the identical exclusion/substitution machinery, giving chained adaptation and reintroduced-exclusion detection.

Scale every quantity by the single Fraction factor target_yield/original_yield at adaptation time; accumulate any substitution yield_factor as drift and divide all quantities by it at the end so the result sits exactly at the target yield.
Collect wording changes during choice application and run them as a deferred pass over fresh copies of main and component instruction strings, warning when an edit matches nothing.
Maintain the equipment set through remove/add edits from chosen substitutions, then check it against available_equipment at the end, emitting 'equipment NAME unavailable' per missing item.

Accumulate reasons and warnings in sets and never short-circuit, so every independently applicable impossibility reason is reported; sort both at return, sort equipment, and set recipe to None when any reason exists.

Build all outputs as new dicts/lists (inputs never mutated) and implement print_original as a direct return of authored_text; include an executable acceptance suite covering all seven required scenarios.
mechanisms: name-indexed catalog with (priority, catalog-order) sorted options for deterministic choice
per-ingredient substitution chain loop with seen-set cycle detection
work queue so additional ingredients re-enter exclusion/substitution processing
single rational scale factor plus yield-drift compensation at the end
deferred wording-change pass over copied instruction strings
accumulated equipment set with final availability check
non-short-circuiting reason/warning accumulator sets, sorted at return
pure construction of fresh output objects; authored_text passthrough for print_original
